subject.title: refactor(channels): move inbound turn execution into core

question: Should this maintainer-labeled, cross-channel lifecycle refactor require refreshed final-head real channel proof, or is the existing earlier Telegram proof plus the provided exact-head regression suite an acceptable proof override?
rationale: The answer sets the acceptable merge-evidence bar for behavior that crosses delivery and session lifecycle boundaries; the supplied author assertion is not an independently established maintainer approval for the current head.
